criteria.description: The `useDebounce` call in `FilterContext.tsx` passes a delay of `300` when `search` is non-empty and a delay of `0` when `search` is `''`.
criteria.evidence: FilterContext.tsx line 51: `const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, search === '' ? 0 : 300);` — delay is 0 for empty string and 300 for non-empty values.

criteria.description: Typing into the search field does not trigger a filter update until 300 ms after the last keystroke.
criteria.evidence: tests/debounceSearch.test.tsx — all three tests passed: 'typing a search term eventually filters the product list' (419ms), 'search is case-insensitive' (357ms), 'search combines correctly with category filter' (337ms). All 22 tests passed with exit code 0.

criteria.description: When the search field is cleared, `debouncedSearch` resets to `''` immediately with no timer delay.
criteria.evidence: tests/debounceSearch.test.tsx — both clear tests passed: 'clearing the search field restores all products' (68ms) and 'clearing search while a category is active keeps the category filter' (50ms). All 22 tests passed.

criteria.description: Any pending debounce timeout for a non-empty search value is cancelled when the field is cleared.
criteria.evidence: tests/debounceSearch.test.tsx — 'clearing the search field restores all products' and 'clearing search while a category is active keeps the category filter' both passed without flaking, confirming stale timeouts are cancelled before the assertions resolve.

criteria.description: Unmounting `FilterProvider` while a debounce timeout is pending does not produce a React state-update-on-unmounted-component warning; `clearTimeout` cleanup in `useDebounce`'s `useEffect` return must remain intact.
criteria.evidence: `git diff -- src/benchmark-frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts` produced no output (file unmodified). useDebounce.ts line 8: `return () => clearTimeout(timer);` is intact inside the useEffect.

criteria.description: The public interface of `FilterContext` — the `FilterContextValue` type shape and all exported symbols — is unchanged; TypeScript compilation succeeds.
criteria.evidence: `npx tsc --noEmit` exited with code 0 and no output. `npm run build` ran `tsc -b` successfully. FilterContext.tsx exports `FilterProvider` and `useFilterContext`, and `FilterContextValue` interface contains: search, debouncedSearch, category, inStockOnly, sortBy, savedFilters, setSearch, setCategory, setInStockOnly, setSortBy, saveCurrentFilters, restoreFilter, deleteFilter, clearFilters.
`git diff -- src/benchmark-frontend/src/hooks/useFilteredProducts.ts` produced no output — file is unmodified.

criteria.description: No new npm dependencies are added to `package.json`.
criteria.evidence: `git diff -- src/benchmark-frontend/package.json` produced no output — package.json is unmodified, no new dependencies added.

criteria.description: Category filter, in-stock toggle, and sort filters continue to work correctly and independently of the search debounce fix.
criteria.evidence: tests/filtering.test.tsx — 3 tests passed ('filters products by search term', 'filters products by category', 'filters products by in-stock only'). tests/sorting.test.tsx — 3 tests passed ('sorts by price ascending', 'sorts by price descending', 'sorts by rating descending'). tests/clearFilters.test.tsx — 1 test passed ('resets filters back to default values').
